reviewed_by: Claude (assistant-pane-child-chats); selection reviewed against the diff by the implementing agent, independent diff review still required before merge
reason: The parent conversation list rendered one section per linked child project and fetched each child's full chat list and activity, so chat-less children showed as empty 'No saved chats' folders and cost two requests each. New Core read GET /api/v1/chat/projects/{id}/linked-chats (src/nebula/v3/linked_project_chats.py, mounted in both the API worker's global reads and the single-process app) returns one bounded page across direct children with activity state, ordered waiting > working > recent before paging; chat_turn_headers gains a cross-project pending-turn query and the session-activity route shares the classification. The UI renders one Subprojects list from it, polls only while the list is visible, and renders nothing when no child has chats. Python: the global project reads tests (new linked-chats case: 40 empty children, active chats ahead of recency across pages, search, grandchild/side-chat/foreign exclusions, ETag 304, no worker contact) and the polling-cost tests for the refactored activity read; the workflow-registry checks because chat.start_and_read's UI calls changed. Frontend: the rewritten component test plus the two SessionsPage suites. Playwright: area:child-project-chats (journey rewritten: many empty children, approval-waiting chat first, paging, search, no per-child reads, open owning project) and area:conversation-order (shares the changed fixture).
exclusions: tests/v3/test_butler_workflow_registry.py::test_reviewed_workflow_registry_matches_ui_api_calls fails identically on origin/main (2 pre-existing unreviewed signatures); this change links its own new call, so the other registry tests are selected by name. PostgreSQL variants in test_runtime_global_project_reads.py skip without NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL; they passed locally against Postgres 16. No setting or new operator destination was added, so the settings catalog and product knowledge index are unchanged. No native or Rust changes.
